asr.full_text: Please Subscribe Aiga Seller Gyan and press the bell icon to watch our E-commerce related videos. Hi friends, I hope you're doing good. Today we will know how to contact a seller support for an Online Marketplace? Every marketplace has different Contact Process and I'll out the difference between the two process. I am Mohamidah, welcome to our youtube channel Zayaga Salar Gyan. Our video has a lot of gap. As you all know that this this was our first sale of this year we have to do lot of preparation for the sale my team and i were busy in preparation of the sale this was the first sale and this sale is very good we hope that, this sale is good for all of you if you want you can share from us your experience next question by yourself by following this channel you would have got new experience so we got a question that how to contact the seller support company some of the place have a contact number some don't so what is the process to contact the seller support company first we will click on help option And now let's look at contact page First one let's start from amazon You can check help option on the right side So click in the help option After helping then below is the option get support So click in get support And you choose from here , query You can ask any query here So example let's first see if you have any issue about account setup and launch So you can see from here some basic information can be known from here. If you want to raise query which is not in this list, then look at the options which is coming at the bottom which is contact us. So you have to go to contact us. Now have a look on the opened page here, there are three options. Email, Phone and Chat. with email, phone and chat you can contact Seller Support Through Email Phone Chat From left hand side There are a lot of categories You have to choose Any category for Queries You have to choose Which fits the most Here see Email First option is Contact Reason Then you have to Describe any issues you have to fill your Email ID and then describe your issue Fill in the email id and phone no. Then a case id is generated here You can check that by go to the case log Then the second option You can talk directly to amazon You need to give your phone no. And fill down your details Then you have to on the call me now then within one minute from Amazon's side you will be informed further option is chat from where you can talk directly with Amazon seller support now lets talk about flipkart see in the right side there are three dots here you have to go and click on contact seller support then you have to select contact seller support. Then a page to ticket dashboard opens. There you can see the details of all the tickets you have raised. Right here, there is an option ask for assistance. You have to select it category wise. You have to ask about orders, listings, payments. You can go to any category and look here and you need to look here is the option Raise a Request You have to select Raise a Request and then you have to select the issue type here. Whatever is the issue about the categories, then select all the issue type here, and here you have to enter your form details in this and then fill a call back phone number and Submit the report. Then you see on the right hand, you will also see the phone number. You can directly call this number to contact Frippkart about any of your issue. Now I will talk about eBay. So first of all, you have to login, you have to make login in the link given and then click is a option on the left side which is Help and Contact. Here also you can see a page has opened, scroll down and you have to click on contact us. And you have to select any topic in a page opened in here. If you select any category in this link, you will get knowledge base here. If you have any query, first of all you will get a knowledge base If there is any query then you can take information from this But if your query is not in this then next you can directly call or chat and ask Here the contact option is call us, call me and chat with us, email us Now see in call us, you can directly contact and ask your query So, it's on all different levels, that is on the search bar. See. On the 3rd you can find on top which tab are available, you can put here any keyword you want. The 3rd one is on the bottom, you can put any keyword that is available on here. option is email Add & let talk about snap deal the last option is support on dashboard click on queries click on new query choose category then then select category then select problem area which you have there ,select it you can find the details of some general issue from here but for some other issue of the query that is not in the list first fill your query in details and if you want to upload any file or image with your query. Click on Attach Files You can attach the files and send them to Paytm. Now let us talk about Paytm. You have to login in Dashboard. Now, go to Seller Help Desk. Now, go to Support. Choose Categories. For example if you have a query related to order. then you need to go to support then you need to choose categories as an example, you have to select any order related query so we will select order processing and handover then you have to select sub category suppose any pickup related issue so you need to select pickup issue also you need to fill you email id then you need to select courier name, pickup issue, subject select, submit ticket, come to home click on check ticket history this will find history if you have raised your ticket now let's get started with shop cruise click on merchant support the right hand side of the page is the option of raise your ticket click on raise ticket select your issue select the reason select all the reason select any of the issues select the Order id Click on the issue click the Reset Ticket option Click on the Ticket history Clicking on view tickets You can click on View Tickets and see directly your queries We hope that you could contact Shelah Support directly Do not forget to Like this video For any Questions please ask us For new requests please subscribe. We will meet in the next video, till then God Bless Until then stay safe
